title: [WithUs Juku] A07 Get All Lesson Allocation API – Current Partner Query Returns Archived LA Rows
description: AC-5 (out-of-package, confirmed unfixable) - Negative: Documents the current behavior for the partner-notification effort - WithUs Juku's own query has no reason to exclude archived LA unless their Postman collection is explicitly updated.
preconditions:
A WithUs Juku Lesson Allocation record exists, archived (Archived_At__c populated, via its order group being fully removed)
WithUs Juku's existing sample Postman request for A07 is available, using whatever WHERE clause their current collection defines (likely date-range/LastModifiedDate-based only, with no archive filter)
steps_actions:
1. "Send WithUs Juku's current A07 request as-is against an org containing the archived LA"
2. "Re-send the same request with 'AND MANAERP__Archived_At__c = null' added to the WHERE clause"
3. "Hand off: recommend the corrected WHERE clause from step 2 as the sample Postman collection update, and flag WithUs Juku for direct partner notification per the existing [SF] Check Partner REST API / Postman collection ticket"
steps_result:
1. "[Documents current state] The archived LA record is returned in the response, indistinguishable from an active one - confirmed structurally unfixable server-side, since Manabie has no Apex layer to filter this partner-constructed query"
2. "The archived LA record is correctly excluded from the response"
3. "Ticket owner has a concrete before/after query pair to act on"
steps_data:
1. "Current query has no Archived_At__c filter"
2. "Corrected query for the Postman collection update"
3. "No server-side fix possible - partner must adopt the corrected query themselves"
